{{Quote|I have a contract from Xizor. The bounty is on Luke Skywalker.|Skahtul|<ref name="DS" />}}
'''Skahtul''' was a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who captured [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and tried to negotiate a larger reward for the capture by playing the two factions who wanted Skywalker against each other. 

==Biography==
Skahtul grew up on [[Barab I]] and dreamed of leaving her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and see other parts of [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In her youth, a group of off worlder [[hunting/Legends|hunters]] visited the [[planet/Legends|planet]] for safari, and they hired her as a guide. After the tour, the leader of the group offered her to become his bearer, responsible for the [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], supplies and traps. Skahtul was trained under them, and fulfilled her dream of seeing many worlds.<ref name="sotesb" /> 

Eventually she realised that hunting [[sentience/Legends|sentients]] was more profitable. She took her leave from her master, promising not to hunt him down should someone put a [[death mark/Legends|death mark]] on him.<ref name="sotesb" />

Skahtul, fuelled only by her [[species/Legends|species]]'s natural aggressiveness, was unable to capture her first [[bounty/Legends|bounty]]. She had to cooperate with other hapless hunters in order to make it, even if they had to split the reward. The colleagues continued together, and Skahtul had the role of planning the group's strategies, eventually becoming their leader. With time, members left and came, especially lone hunters who saught security in numbers. Although her mates were fairly successful and able, the team was less than prestigious.<ref name="sotesb" /> 

===Hunt for Skywalker===
{{Quote|At last, Skywalker, we meet.|Skahtul|<ref name="DS" />}}
In the peak of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] put a bounty for the safe capture of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] the [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] posted bounty on Skywalker's head. Skahtul accepted the contract, with the goal to capture Skywalker first, and bargain with both parties to raise the reward.<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[File:SkahtulStalksSkywalker-ShadowSyndicate.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skahtul, following [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]]]
She tracked Skywalker to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where, in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], she met an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operative, who would provide her with backup. The two planned to ambush Skywalker when he would approach Xizor, observing the [[Mos Espa Circuit|Mos Espa Race]]. [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Company]] had provided several large luxury sand barges from which spectators could watch the race; Skahtul was allowed onto Xizor's personal barge, where she waited for Skywalker to arrive.<ref name="DS" />

After finally spotting the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Skahtul stepped in front of him, armed with a heavy blaster pistol. However, Skywalker was ready for the encounter, because he had lured the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] into his trap, and not the other way around. During the battle an errant blaster bolt hit the steering vane of the sail barge, and it careened out of control. Following the barge's crash into sand, Skahtul saw no sign of the Jedi, but was determined to continue her pursuit.<ref name="DS" />

Skahtul realized that Skywalker was too powerful to be dealt alone, but only with superior numerical strength. She decided to join forces with colleagues and competitors; contacting [[Calliose]] and other hunters and [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], she formed a [[Skahtul's coalition|coalition]] of bounty hunters.<ref name="sotesb" /> 
[[File:Skahtul.jpg|thumb|Skahtul]]
Finally, her more experienced cooperatives tracked Skywalker to [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]],<ref name="sotesb" /> where they [[Battle of Kothlis|stormed]] a [[Bothan safehouse]], finally captured Luke Skywalker. Skywalker was wanted dead by Xizor, but alive by Vader. As such, Skahtul kept Skywalker in [[Skahtul's hideout|a compound]] on Kothlis while she tried to get the highest price out of them. She visited him twice in his cell explaining her plans, warning him that she might have to kill him according to the bounty's prices; despite being sympathetic to his cause.<ref name="sote">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="sote4">[[Shadows of the Empire 4|''Shadows of the Empire'' 4]]</ref> 

This backfired, as Skywalker escaped the compound with the help of his [[Force power/Legends|Jedi powers]], and was soon joined by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] who came to his rescue.<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote4" /><ref name="sote5">[[Shadows of the Empire 5|''Shadows of the Empire'' 5]]</ref>  While the mercenaries tried to defend themselves against the two humans, Skahtul also noticed that Calliose's ruffians were firing against her mates.<ref name="partners">{{WEGCite|story=Partners No More|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> Around that time, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and his forces [[Battle of Kothlis|attacked Kothlis]], coming after Luke. As [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] invaded the hideout,<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote5" /> Calliose's men left, and Skahtul ran after him, thinking that the cost of the operation was not worth the trouble.<ref name="partners" />
[[File:Calliose.jpg|thumb|left|Skahtul accusing Calliose.]]
Skahtul caught up with Calliose several blocks away and confronted him, disarming and pushing him against the wall. She accused him for shooting against her men, and for treachery as she threw him down and kicked him, and slamming the Nikto against the wall. She knew that there was a bounty on his head by the [[Klatooinian Trade Guild/Legends|Klatooinian Trade Guild]], and as the bounty hunter tended to eliminate "competition" to keep himself safe. Calliose denied all those accusations, but Skahtul, although didn't intend to betray him at first, thought it was the proper time to get some profit from that disastrous operation. Restraining him with [[cuffbands]], she decided to deliver him to the Guild.<ref name="partners" />

===On Hurd's Moon===
[[4 ABY/Legends|A year later]], Skahtul was on [[Hurd's Moon]] and met with [[Savan]], the niece of Xizor, who was on a mission to capture the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]]. The droid was under the protection of her creator, the droid scientist [[Massad Thrumble]], when [[Kar Yang]], hired by Savan, invaded his protected place to steal Guri. After the failed attempt, Thrumble upgraded his security making impossible for anyone else to approach Guri, and Skahtul informed Savan of the difficult situation. Skahtul advised Savan to wait until Guri left before they would be able to capture her, though Savan ignored her.<ref>[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 4|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 4]]</ref>
==Personality and traits==
Skahtul was exceptional among Barabels in that she wished to see other parts of the galaxy, and thrive in cooperation. While Barabels had a natural aggression towards others, Skahtul had to overcome this instinct in order to benefit from teamwork and superior numbers. While being with a team, Skahtul was the main business and battle strategist, becoming essentially a leader. Skahtul was keeping up especially with bounties coming from [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="sotesb" /> 

As a leader, Skahtul did not resolve to threats, but inspired loyalty with deeds; she was notably loyal and protective to her teammates, who, to her annoyance, sometimes called her "mother".<ref name="sotesb" />

In Barabel tradition, Jedi were hightly respected, and she understood it as admiration of superior battle abilities; and when the bounty on Skywalker came, she didn't let her respect get between her and the reward.<ref name="sotesb" /> She admired what Luke had done against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], even having some sympathies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but she needed [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]].

Skahtul was often seen with a black hunting fatigues on which she attached her arsenal of weapons.<ref name="sotesb" />
